reviews.t: Damaging to hair/ Ruined my hair !!! :(
reviews.x: WARNING! This product is advertised as being a thermal heat protection spray. It is not, it completely damaged my hair!!!! I had to go back to salon literally the month after I just got it cut because the ends were fried to the max, even my hairdresser was mortified as to what damaged my hair. I had to pay a pretty penny for a deep conditioning salon treatment to get my hair back to normal.  Also, it smells really bad though if it actually worked I won't mind it as much.  Do not waste your money

This is a "must" for anyone that uses heat on their hair.  I have naturally curly/frizzy hair that I absolutely hate, so I blow-dry and straighten my hair every day.  That is a lot of heat for hair to withstand.  This blow dry spray protects my hair from all that heat.  My process is as follows: I wash and gently towel dry my hair, then spray this on my damp hair. But I really don't like oil type because sometimes I put a little bit more my hair kind of too greasy.  After I received this Opulent Blow dry spray I already use two days now, I will say this product not only really reduces the time of blow dry your hair but it helps my hair so smooth and shine. I am always looking for something to shorten the amount of time that I spend on drying my hair and styling it. I ordered the product and anixously awaited its arrival. After washing my hair, I sprayed my hair with it being sure I covered spraying all of my hair. When I brushed it after, I noticed there were no tangles. This has a pleasant smell to me. I turned the sprayer off when finished. The sprayer

I use this, when my hair is still wet. I spray it into my hair and massage it in. Then, I blow dry my hair. This spray makes my hair dry faster, but then my hair is so soft and shiny. I blow dry my hair every day. In the past, my hair gets dry, damaged and splits within a few months. But, this protects my hair so well, I haven't seen any splits in the last few months. I'm really happy with this product.

Was looking for an alternative to Bed Head thermal spray. And it was less than average in my opinion left my dry and not as soft as the previous thermal sprays. Although it didn't cut my drying time ( I have 4a/4b hair) it help speed up the process a bit. I don't think I will order again wasn't good for me

I'm very pleased with this product.  It does cut down on the drying time and seems to help style my hair better. I'd used a product in the past that did this, but it caused my scalp to itch. I have no itchy side effects with this product.

Do not like the smell. Smells like yucky hair spray. Does smooth hair out a bit but not enough to purchase & deal with that smell. I am just one person though & this is my opinion. Yours may be different. Give it a try.

It arrived quickly but the box was wet. I opened the box just to find a empty bottle. .... I was going to return it but my husband though it was trash and threw it away.  No evidence no return right? Smh

reviews.t: Smells nice, wouldn't say it cuts my drying time in ...
reviews.x: Smells nice,  wouldn't say it cuts my drying time in half but I do think it speeds up the process.  Will probably reorder.
This product is great. Smells so good and leaves my hair so soft not oily or stiff anything. I would def recommend this.

When I want to my to stay curly I spray this in and then flip my head over and blow dry for only a few seconds. I do not want it completely dry because my curls or waves however my hair feels like acting won't do right. This product does weigh my hair a little. But I expect it when ever I use any product in my hair. This has a very nice

reviews.t: Opulent Thermal Blowout Spray - Awesome Product!
reviews.x: Finally a heat protector that really works on my hair! I have used quite a few different brands and ended up with either dried-out or sticky hair. I have very abused hair - colored, bleached, blow-dried and flat-ironed. This works for me. I have thick, longer hair so I have to do about 15 - 20 spritzes. This product does not make my hair sticky or oily, and it does not weigh it down. I am so glad I found this and decided to give it a try! I strongly recommend this for anyone with naturally curly

reviews.t: I don't recommend this if you're trying to get that full straight ...
reviews.x: I am hispanic and have long dark hair. I naturally have wavy hair. Due to constant coloring and processing, I tried this to help save my hair which I don't know if it does anything really and my hair feels the same as if I wouldn't have put this on after blow drying. Soooooo...I don't recommend this if you're trying to get that full straight shine IF you have my type of wavy frizzy hair, didn't work well for me. But if you have amazing sleek hair, maybe you could benefit from it.

Reading the other reviews, I have to wonder if I received a different product from everyone else. This did not decrease my drying time. It did not leave my hair shiny; instead, it felt tacky and sticky and looked dull. I tried using less and got the same result, just to a lesser extent. I had to use a sulfate shampoo to get this stuff off my hair. I'm giving it to my 10-year-old daughter to use as a detangling spray, since that's all it's good for.

Owned this for awhile and didn’t use it, always buying the recommended salon products. Decided to try his without all the other goop I put on my hair after washing ( foam setter etc). This alone does the best job. Leaves hair light but manageable, shiny and doesn’t feel thick. Love it but the bad news is can’t find where to buy it. Company website doesn’t seem operative and amazon says it’s not available. Somebody out there suggest something!

reviews.t: I'm glad to have tried it
reviews.x: This helps my hair go from a tangled half-curly unruly wet mess to something manageable. I don't actually blow out my hair yet it helps anyways. I can both comb through it and notice the sleekness the next time I shower. It isn't too heavy, unless I hit my quasi-bangs too hard and wait a day.  Not the traditional slick oil or sticky hairspray. I'm glad to have tried it.

Great product.  It has a light clean scent and a fine mist spray - which I love.  Hair dryer quick and smooth.  Ive tried a few different products like this over the years and this is definitely one of tops.  -  I have long thick curly/wave hair that frizzes easy - this keeps it straight, frizz free and not greesey for at least 3 days sometimes I even push to 4.

reviews.t: and it doesn't hurt that this smells amazing. You won't get that burning hair smell when ...
reviews.x: Got this because I straightened my hair a lot and was starting to see some breakage. After cutting my straighting down a bit and using this when I did decide too I seen my hair health improve so much, and it doesn't hurt that this smells amazing. You won't get that burning hair smell when using this.

reviews.t: Not good for fine, thin, hair!
reviews.x: This is just okay. It smells alright, and seems to work okay as well. However, it weighs my hair down (I have thin, fine hair). This makes it too soft to hold a style. So I do not suggest it for anyone with the similar type of hair. There are better Protectants out better formulated for fine hair.

Used Kendra blow day spray and loved it but went through it fast and needed a cheaper alternative. Tried some other stuff from on here (it's pink) but I hated the smell. This stuff smells great, works great, and gives my hair an extra smoothness instead of the frizz I got from the other stuff.

I am shocked at how quickly my hair dried with this product.  It isn't sticky, it was easy to use, love the great fine spray that comes out so that it gets all over your hair.  I will be buying this again for sure.

reviews.t: Not sure if this actually does anything to quicken the ...
reviews.x: Not sure if this actually does anything to quicken the drying time, but I need oils added into my hair & it's pleasant enough to smell.  I'll finish the bottle, but won't likely buy again.

reviews.t: This stuff worked great on my fine limp hair but I unfortunately developed ...
reviews.x: This stuff worked great on my fine limp hair but I unfortunately developed a rash around my neck. I stopped using it and it went away. Oh well- I would use if not for the rash.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it protects hair from heat and leaves it soft and shiny, with several calling it the best heat protectant they've used.
Some reviewers report it speeds up blow-drying time, though a few say the effect is modest or didn't cut drying time.
A few reviewers say it did not work for them, leaving hair dry or feeling no different after use.
Opinions on the scent are mixed, with some praising how it smells and others disliking it as smelling like hair spray.
One reviewer reports the product damaged their hair, and another received an empty bottle.
